title: A regular pledge passes only if its exact value reaches minPledgeUsd and a rescue top-up only if it reaches min(minPledgeUsd, $10) and is eligible within the restore amount; an eligible rescue at or above that minimum is never refused for value; the booked charge is >= 1 and never below the value

After a passing pledge: sliceUsd <= usdCharge and > 0 only for an eligible top-up within restoreBooked; a non-zero slice fits topUpSliceUsd and the token and depositor counters exceed their caps by at most the slice; rescueUnits is L for a rescue, ceil(L*sliceUsd/usdCharge) for a slice top-up, 0 otherwise, and never above L
Pledge price-state rule of the RiskModule equals the LPOracle state-effects table (read from 2.10) for new accounts and top-ups, including the token-decimals rows

Every tighten setter (19 ParameterStore parameters) moves only in the safer direction inside its hard and liveness bounds; every step-limited loosening moves one step (x1.5 exact product, slice base max(old, floor(cap/10)), +25 bps) at least normalDelay >= 345,600 s after the previous one and records its time

slippageAllowanceBps never goes below slippageAllowanceMinBps(m), the floor never above the allowance, and the floor always covers the worst swap-route cost of every enabled debt asset, so every accepted allowance admits the honest swap (no buy leg exists)
detail: Changed for the AMM-neutral design: the buy-leg allowance and its floor were removed (REQ-PSTORE-006); the per-market slippage floor is the lower side for every debt asset.

title: minLB x (10^4 - slippageAllowanceMinBps) >= 10^4 x (10^4 + maxFlashFeeBps) holds for every Active/Offboarding market and enabled debt reserve after every slippageAllowanceMinBps or maxFlashFeeBps change, activateMarket, enableDebtReserve and reserve removal (inductive step, per pair)
detail: Changed for the AMM-neutral design: one swap leg per pool token into the debt asset, so the two-leg inequality with a buy allowance became the single-leg inequality of REQ-PSTORE-021. minLB is Aave configuration read at each check; an Aave bonus cut after activation is drift (REQ-HUB-108).

title: Spec examples: minLB 10,200 with floor 30 bps gives 101,694,000, which admits maxFlashFeeBps 10 and 169 and refuses 170; raising the floor to 35 for a 35 bps route still passes at 10 bps; floor max(15, 30) = 30 admits tightening to 30, refuses 29 and a floor of 51 above a 50 bps allowance

REQ-PSTORE-024 example: the exact check phi x 10^4 <= 10 x 20,000e6 = 2e11 passes the 5 bps premium (10 USDC, 1e11) and refuses a 15 bps premium (30 USDC, 3e11), so the keeper funds the debt; 2.9 has no buy-leg setter
detail: Changed for the AMM-neutral design: the old GHO buy-leg example is replaced by the flash-fee ceiling, checked in the exact form phi x 10^4 <= maxFlashFeeBps x amount (no rounded ceiling).

title: Breaker thresholds (Q-399): the 2.9 table holds only breakerDeficitMax (10,000 GHO launch), lowered at the short delay within [0, firstLossReserveMinimum]; the price-drop, seizure and route-failure thresholds and breakerCooldown are monitoring settings, not stored trips; poolShareMaxBps is the one concentration parameter, lowered within [0, 10,000]

tightenMaxShortfallBps lowers within [0, 5,000] and never widens any leg's slippage; tightenDebtStressRiseBps raises within [100, 5,000] and the served stress price ceil(accepted*(10^4+rise)/10^4) is never below the accepted price; spec examples hold

Three loosenings of one key span at least 2 x MIN_NORMAL_DELAY = 691,200 s and raise a cap by at most 3.375x, however normalDelay moves within its bounds (no health-factor parameter is loosened: Q-398)

Spec examples: a second loosening at T + 3 days LoosenTooSoon(T + 432,000); $5M -> $7.5M accepted, +1 refused; 100 -> 125 bps accepted, 126 refused; 40 -> 65 -> 90 -> 100 in three steps; a slice at 0 restores to 1.5 x cap/10; 50 -> 75 bps, 76 refused

Spec examples: $99,995 charge and value at 199,990,000; $50,000 charge at the $1 floor; 999,950,000 and 999,934,990 below $10, 1,000,149,990 and 1,000,134,976 above; a $12 rescue passes and a $12 ordinary top-up fails at minPledgeUsd $50
REQ-RISK-057 and REQ-RISK-066 name the same revert for every pledge below a minimum

Every page (1.4 role table, 1.5 class column, 2.9 setter table and REQ-CONFIG-049, 2.15 launch list, 3.8 MKT-027) names the same parameters as having a short-delay tighten selector, with the same safer direction, under the compiled ParameterStore selector names; no page or compiled source names a SettlementBudget selector (Q-397); usdBand and grace parameters have none on any page
detail: 25 parameters compared over 6 page readings; 22 ParameterStore compiled tighten selectors compared with 3 page readings; 8 SettlementBudget readings checked empty

title: The SettlementBudget is removed (Q-397): contracts/src holds no settlement-budget interface and no source names it, so no cap, window, reserved floor or draw exists to configure
REQ-CONFIG-050 replacement (Q-397): the 2.15 launch short-delay list names no SettlementBudget selector, so floorRoundingAllowance is bounded by its own bounds only

Without a SettlementBudget every settlement balances from the caller: with the top-up equal to the rounding gap max(0, D + premium - funding - proceeds), funding + proceeds + top-up >= D + premium, and the top-up is 0 whenever proceeds and funding already cover D + premium

Q-397 example: a 10,000 GHO repay flash-borrowed at 5 bps (premium 5 GHO) with 10,004.2 GHO of proceeds leaves a 0.8 GHO gap that the keeper pays as its top-up; with 10,005 GHO of proceeds the top-up is 0
No per-market budget window remains (Q-397): no source names a market window cap, so one market's liquidations can never draw down another market's settlement funds

Under any sequence of tighten, loosen, structural and setFeed calls every relational bound stays satisfied: slice <= cap, borrowPriceMaxAge <= min(heartbeat + 600, 4,200) and <= liquidationPriceMaxAge, heartbeat < feedMaxAge <= liquidationPriceMaxAge, slippage floor, grace bounds, poolShareMaxBps <= 10,000, buy floor <= allowance
No borrow, withdraw-with-debt or new-account pledge completes while any Spoke can draw the vault-token asset
detail: The sum of Borrow Spoke drawCaps against the credit line is Aave DAO configuration checked by the live-config check.
